details: The qualification input reader selects the v1 source 4.2.0 or v2 source 4.2.1 manifest schema and expected package identities. Unsupported or mixed schema kinds and self-hashed rows with incorrect source versions or row schemas are refused.

Historical output identities use CCC01 separately from frozen CCC00 target records. Existing target-record hashes, terminal seals, predecessor inventories, private output boundaries, source bindings and actual candidate archive checks remain required.

Permanent portable controls exercise both nine-target input versions and malformed rows. Modern packages and terminal predecessor inventories are controlled fixtures; actual native qualification and release acceptance remain outstanding.

Independent rehash, engine and later release consumers require separate current-version acceptance. Reading a private package set does not establish qualification, support expansion, signing, promotion, tagging or publication authority.
